title: Can I GAMBLE Dice Chess?
summary: Dice Chess (three piece dice) vs online humans (e.g. Veer2929) on the dice-chess site; goal 5 wins, reached in 6 games: W (pawn move captures king), W (double knight), L, W, W, W.
rules: Each turn the player rolls three dice (ROLL button); each die face shows a piece type (pawn, knight, bishop, rook, queen, king).

You may make one move per die with a piece of the rolled type (e.g. 'double pawn and queen' = two pawn moves and one queen move in the same turn); unusable dice are wasted ('rolls nothing' = turn passes).
Moves within a turn are made one after another; a move of one rolled piece can open lines for the next (e.g. move the knight out, then bishop captures the king).
No check/checkmate: the king may be left or moved into attack; capturing the enemy king wins.
Castling allowed if you roll king and rook in the same turn and the king hasn't moved.
win_condition: Capture the enemy king. Goal: 5 wins.
